svg.title: Spead AI Pro for WIKA stack
svg.desc: Frontend: Vanilla JS single-page app, three.js, React 19, Vite. Backend: Node 22, TypeScript, Fastify 5, zod, npm workspaces. Data: PostgreSQL, PGlite for local tests, Encrypted file storage, int8 vector index. AI: LLM providers, e5-small embeddings, Reranker via onnxruntime, OCR, pdf.js. Ops: ONLYOFFICE Docs, nginx, systemd, SMTP, Playwright
svg.text: Versions as pinned in the project.
